title: TypedefRead
description: Output of `typedef read`. With an `<id>` argument: one type definition read back — its value `kind` and the per-kind CONFIG block in the SAME shape `typedef add` accepts (`number`/`string`/`enum`/…). With NO argument: the declared local ids under `typedefs`, plus any `importedFrom` sources (type-defs merged in from other models). The handle to then read one.

kind.description: (one) the value kind — the SAME vocabulary the `typedef add` `kind` key / `field read` / `model describe` use (STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM | DATE | DATE_TIME | TIME | DATE_FRAGMENT | DATE_RANGE | ENUMERATION | CUSTOM | UNKNOWN), never the raw kernel discriminator

number.description: (one, NUMBER) min/max/unit/scale/rendered-length/integer-digit config, the shape `typedef add` accepts

dateRange.description: (one, DATE_RANGE) format/separator config, plus interpretationOfYear when the declaration carries it (absent means the STANDARD default, which has no spelling). The block is a legal `field add`/`field modify` input, so a read round-trips

typedefs.description: (name-index) every declared local type-def id, in document order — pass one back as `typedef read <id>`

importedFrom.description: (name-index) other models whose type-defs this model imports (resolve to files via `model info`); present only when imports exist
